info.description: Unreleased, non-normative review artifact. Not merged into the published base contract or live conformance verdict. post.description: Single-holder transitions require expected_revision; all-participant complete/fail updates the actor's fixed report. Group complete proposes an agreement decision, requires the room revision header, and does not immediately complete. A successor to a completed exact-reviewed artifact result must request exact review instead; complete rejects with 400. Cancellation abandons rather than approves.
